title: Torium, QoL
description: Torium with Quality of Life mods!
body:
Torium is a lightweight NeoForge modpack focused on improving Minecraft's performance, visuals, and quality-of-life features while keeping the vanilla experience intact.

Built for players who want smoother gameplay, better optimization, useful utilities, shader support, and multiplayer-friendly enhancements without changing the core progression of Minecraft.

Features:
### Performance Improvements

Torium includes a carefully selected set of optimization mods to boost FPS, reduce memory usage, improve chunk loading, and create a smoother overall experience.

- Sodium
- Lithium
- ModernFix
- FerriteCore
- ImmediatelyFast
- Entity Culling
- Dynamic FPS
- BadOptimizations
- Model Fix
- Acendium, Nvidium
- Chloride
- Fast Paintings
- GPU Tape
### 
### Visual Enhancements

- Iris Shader Support
- Better Clouds
- Continuity
- Entity Texture Features
- Entity Model Features
- 3D Skin Layers
- Sodium Extra
- Reese's Sodium Options
- Sodium Shadowy Path Blocks

### Exploration & Utility

- Xaero's Minimap
- Xaero's World Map
- Jade
- AppleSkin
- JEI (Just Enough Items)
- Shulker Box Tooltip
- Mouse Tweaks
- Durability Tooltip
- Advancement Plaques
- Better Beds
- Boat View

### Multiplayer Enhancements

- Simple Voice Chat
- e4mc (Easy LAN Sharing)
- No Chat Reports

### Additional Improvements

- Clumps
- Chunky
- Freecam
- Connector
- Forgified Fabric API
- Moonlight Lib
- Iceberg
- Palladium
- ToadLib
- YACL
- CWB
- RRLS

Torium aims to be the perfect everyday Minecraft pack: fast, polished, and packed with useful enhancements while preserving the game you already love.
